leads.Personalized Subject Line: A haveli giving up its secret: trailer idea for Whispers
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Harshali,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Whispers of the Buried Past and Anarkali- The Courtesan, the Pawn and the Queen while researching your work. I was particularly interested in the buried body that surfaces during the renovation of the haveli, leaving the reluctant heir Dheeraj haunted until he confronts his family's past, and in Anarkali's story inside Akbar's harem at Lahore's Shahi Mahal.

Those details gave me an idea for how a book trailer could help present the Haveli Series to more of the readers who may enjoy it. A short, atmospheric trailer for Whispers of the Buried Past, built on dust, lantern light and a haveli giving up its secret, could introduce the fourth book while inviting new readers back to A Window to Her Dreams.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

A four-book Haveli Series supports a follow-on roadmap.
